nodes.question: How do multi-level governance cultures influence the co-creation of experiments and their impact on urban sustainability?
nodes.answer: Multi-level governance cultures can enable collaboration and sharing of resources between different levels of government, leading to more holistic and effective urban sustainability initiatives.
